1. (Currently amended) A system comprising: a plurality of network nodes of a local contention neighborhood of a random access network, wherein a first node is configured to transmit to a second node at an access attempt percentage, and wherein each of __the plurality of network nodes__ is configured to provide __to at least another one of the plurality of network nodes__ an indicia of its inter-node interference [[to others of the nodes]], and wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage to transmit to the second node based on one of the provided indicia.

2. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the indicia of inter-node interference comprises an indicia of transmission success between the other nodes and the second node.

3. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the indicia of inter-node interference is based on a minimum desired throughput for __the particular node providing the indicia__.

4. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage based on the indicia of inter-node interference of the first node divided by an indicia of inter-node interference of one or more of the nodes interfered with by transmissions from the first node.

5. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the second node comprises a wireless local area network access point.

13. (Previously presented) A system comprising: a first node adapted to communicate wirelessly with a first access point, the first node configured to calculate an access attempt percentage for communications with the first access point, wherein the calculation is based at least partially on a received indicia of inter-node interference between the first node and a second node.

14. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13, comprising the first access point, wherein the first access point is configured to broadcast __a__ dynamic weight associated with the second node to the first node.

15. (Original) The system of claim 13, wherein the first node is configured to calculate its access attempt percentage based on a dynamic weight of the first node, wherein the dynamic weight of the first node is based on a transmission success rate between the first node and the first access point.

16. (Original) The system of claim 13, wherein the first node is configured to calculate its access attempt percentage based on a dynamic weight broadcast by the second node, wherein the dynamic weight of the second node is based on a transmission success rate of the second node.

17. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13, comprising a second access point, wherein the second node communicates with the second access point and the first node interferes with communication between the second node and the second access point.

18. (Original) The system of claim 13, wherein the first node is configured to calculate the access attempt percentage based at least partially on the transmission success rate between the first node and the first access point.

19. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13, wherein the first node is configured to communicate with the first access point using __an IEEE 802.11 wireless local area network protocol__.

20. (Original) The system of claim 13, wherein the first node is configured to recalculate the access attempt percentage after a predetermined number of slots.
